name: Yuliia Starodubtseva
nicknameOrTagline: From tennis teacher to tennis star
intro: Yuliia Starodubtseva is from Kakhovka, Ukraine. She went to college in Virginia and once worked as a tennis teacher. Now she beats top players on the biggest stages.
story: Yuliia played college tennis at Old Dominion University in Virginia. After school, she taught tennis lessons at a club near New York City. Friends and supporters helped her chase her pro dream. It worked! This spring she reached her first big final, and she beat the No. 2 seed in Paris.

funFacts.text: She has two college degrees, one in communication and one in sport management.
She taught tennis on green clay courts near New York City before turning pro.
She loves driving cars and listening to techno music.
She cheers for the Green Bay Packers football team.
In 2024 she qualified for all four Grand Slams. No woman had done that in the modern era.
Her supporters set up a fund to help her chase her pro dream.
She picked tennis at age 5, just for fun. It got serious around age 11.

watchFor: Watch how steady she is from the baseline. When she beat the No. 2 seed in Paris, she made far fewer mistakes than her opponent.
